## Objective
- Upgrade the existing Eldoria game’s graphics while preserving its gameplay systems and controls.

## Requirements
- Improve natural terrain, forests and vegetation, medieval village assets, player visuals, lighting and shadows, water, sky and atmosphere, and draw distance.
- Keep mobile controls, combat, stamina, vitality, quests, and movement functional.
- Avoid placeholder primitive geometry for major environmental assets.
- Build directly without asking clarification; capture and inspect a small JPEG screenshot for checks.

## Decisions
- Enhanced the existing procedural Three.js scene without replacing its gameplay systems or requiring external assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `index.html` with textured, more finely tessellated terrain, more irregular distant mountain meshes, denser instanced forest and grass, more detailed cottage roofs and props, village paths, upgraded player armor, animated river surface, and increased camera draw distance.
- JavaScript syntax check passed using `node --check /tmp/opencode/eldoria-check.mjs`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Started a local HTTP server on port 3002 and confirmed the page responds with HTTP 200.

### Active
- Browser-verify the game visually and functionally; save and inspect a latest small JPEG screenshot.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Open `http://localhost:3002` with `playwright-cli`; inspect the active scene and console/runtime errors.
2. Save a JPEG screenshot at no more than 1280px wide, then read the latest image.
3. Fix any issues found and summarize the completed visual upgrades and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: all game rendering, environment generation, gameplay, and interface code.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`.
- A Python HTTP server was started with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- The first syntax-check attempt failed because Node could not open the process-substitution path (`ENOENT`); the subsequent temporary-file syntax check passed.

playwright-cli - run playwright mcp commands from terminal

Usage: playwright-cli <command> [args] [options]
Usage: playwright-cli -s=<session> <command> [args] [options]

Core:
  open [url]                  open the browser
  attach [name]               attach to a running playwright browser
  close                       close the browser
  detach                      detach from an attached browser
  goto <url>                  navigate to a url
  type <text>                 type text into editable element
  click <target> [button]     perform click on a web page
  dblclick <target> [button]  perform double click on a web page
  fill <target> <text>        fill text into editable element
  drag <startTarget> <endTarget> perform drag and drop between two elements
  drop <target>               drop files or data onto an element
  hover <target>              hover over element on page
  select <target> <val>       select an option in a dropdown
  upload <files...>           upload one or multiple files
  check <target>              check a checkbox or radio button
  uncheck <target>            uncheck a checkbox or radio button
  snapshot [target]           capture page snapshot to obtain element ref
  find [text]                 search the page snapshot for text or a regexp, returning matching nodes with surrounding context (like search snippets)
  eval <func> [target]        evaluate javascript expression on page or element
  dialog-accept [prompt]      accept a dialog
  dialog-dismiss              dismiss a dialog
  resize <w> <h>              resize the browser window
  delete-data                 delete session data

Navigation:
  go-back                     go back to the previous page
  go-forward                  go forward to the next page
  reload                      reload the current page

Keyboard:
  press <key>                 press a key on the keyboard, `a`, `arrowleft`
  keydown <key>               press a key down on the keyboard
  keyup <key>                 press a key up on the keyboard

Mouse:
  mousemove <x> <y>           move mouse to a given position
  mousedown [button]          press mouse down
  mouseup [button]            press mouse up
  mousewheel <dx> <dy>        scroll mouse wheel

Save as:
  screenshot [target]         screenshot of the current page or element
  pdf                         save page as pdf

Tabs:
  tab-list                    list all tabs
  tab-new [url]               create a new tab
  tab-close [index]           close a browser tab
  tab-select <index>          select a browser tab

## Objective
- Upgrade the existing Eldoria game’s graphics while preserving its gameplay systems and controls.
- Verify the updated scene in a browser and inspect a small JPEG screenshot.

## Requirements
- Improve terrain, forests and vegetation, village, player, lighting and shadows, water, sky and atmosphere, and draw distance.
- Keep mobile controls, combat, stamina, vitality, quests, and movement functional.
- Avoid placeholder primitive geometry for major environmental assets.
- Build directly without asking clarification; capture and inspect a JPEG at no more than 1280px wide.

## Decisions
- Enhance the existing procedural Three.js scene without replacing gameplay systems or requiring external assets.

## Work State
### Completed
- Updated `index.html` with textured, more finely tessellated terrain, irregular distant mountain meshes, denser instanced forest and grass, more detailed cottages and props, village paths, upgraded player armor, animated river surface, and increased camera draw distance.
- Improved ground texture brightness and adjusted ambient and sunlight levels after inspecting an initial browser screenshot.
- JavaScript syntax check passed using `/tmp/opencode/eldoria-check.mjs`; `git diff --check` passed.
- Local server on port 3002 responds with HTTP 200; browser loaded the page and confirmed the canvas and game HUD.

### Active
- Recheck the latest lighting and terrain changes in the browser, enter the game, inspect console/runtime errors, and capture/read a fresh small JPEG.
- Confirm gameplay controls still work.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Refresh `http://localhost:3002`, enter the realm, and inspect the scene and console.
2. Save a fresh JPEG at no more than 1280px wide and read it.
3. Fix any issues, then summarize the visual upgrades and verification.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: game rendering, environment generation, gameplay, and interface.
- `screenshots/eldoria-latest.jpg`: existing screenshot, captured before the latest lighting and terrain adjustments.

## Important Context
- Changes are uncommitted in `index.html`.
- A local Python HTTP server is running on port 3002.
- Browser console previously showed a missing `/favicon.ico` (404) and SwiftShader GPU stall warnings; no gameplay runtime error was reported.
- The latest browser refresh occurred, but the realm was not re-entered and no screenshot has yet been captured after the final adjustments.
